content: In case of fire: Alert nearby occupants immediately. Do NOT use elevators; use emergency exits and stairwells only. Pull the nearest manual fire alarm. If smoke is heavy, stay low to the floor and cover your nose and mouth with a wet cloth.
Evacuation Routes: Primary exit is Main Emergency Gate A on the ground floor. Secondary exit is West Wing Gate B. Follow the green illuminated EXIT signs. Keep corridors clear of all obstructions.

Smoke Inhalation Response: Move the affected person to an open area with fresh air immediately. Keep them warm and rested. If unconscious or struggling to breathe, call emergency medical services immediately.

MACMS Automation: When a HIGH or CRITICAL risk level is detected, the system automatically unlocks main exit gates, triggers audio-visual alarms, and dispatches real-time alerts via Telegram and Firebase FCM.
Assembly Point: The designated safe assembly area is the Main Outdoor Parking Lot, located 50 meters away from Main Gate A.
